cases.sentence: Через два дня наступала Пасха и праздник ___.
cases.explain: «Пресных хлебов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

cases.translation: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

cases.sentence: Он возлежал за столом, когда в дом вошла женщина с ___ очень дорогого ароматического масла, приготовленного из чистого нарда .
cases.explain: «алебастровым кувшином» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

cases.translation: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

cases.sentence: И Иуда стал искать ___, чтобы предать Иисуса.
cases.explain: «удобного случая» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

cases.sentence: В ___ праздника Пресных хлебов, когда закалывали пасхальных ягнят, ученики спросили Иисуса:
cases.explain: «первый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

cases.sentence: В первый день праздника ___, когда закалывали пасхальных ягнят, ученики спросили Иисуса:
cases.explain: «Пресных хлебов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

cases.sentence: Скажите хозяину дома, куда этот человек войдет: «Учитель спрашивает: где Моя комната, в которой Я буду есть ___ с Моими учениками?»
cases.explain: «пасхальный ужин» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?” ’

cases.explain: «пасхальный ужин» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He came the third time, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

cases.translation: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

cases.sentence: И тотчас во ___ пропел петух, и Петр вспомнил слова Иисуса: «Прежде чем два раза пропоет петух, ты трижды отречешься от Меня».
cases.explain: «второй раз» — after the preposition «во», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
